items.title: Meet Skore: the enterprise platform for building reliable Tabular AI models faster
items.author: Probabl
items.content:
<article>We’re excited to announce the launch of Skore 🚀 

Skore is the solution for data science teams in the age of agentic AI. Agents can generate pipelines in seconds and build models in minutes, work that used to take teams days or even weeks. But speed without human judgment and guardrails has a cost: silent errors, security risks, opaque costs, and predictive models nobody can audit. Enterprises not only want speed but also need confidence that their predictive models are trained with the methodology and statistical thinking they'd expect from a seasoned data scientist.

At @probabl_ai we firmly believe that speed and confidence in the results should never be a trade-off. This is where Skore comes in. Its agents build, validate, and track models and apply the statistical methodology of the @scikit-learn maintainers at every step. Skore is the essential methodology layer for building predictive models on tabular data with AI agents, with validation, governance, and reproducibility built in by design. 

We’re the team behind scikit-learn. We've seen millions of models built. We created Skore so the next millions can be even better.

👉 Learn more about Skore on our website: https://www.probabl.ai/skore/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=skore_launch_2026&utm_content=company-page-post</article>
